title: Jerusalem, Rejoice
description: Jerusalem, Rejoice in Tonic Solfa to SOUTHWELL, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the East (Paisley, in print by 1911), headed “_Refrain._”.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Short Metre (6.6.8.6), and this page sets them to SOUTHWELL; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Je-ru-sa-lem, re-joice! Keep fes-ti-val and sing; All ye who dwell in Zi-on's courts, Bring forth an of-fer-ing.

lines: All ye who dwell in Zion's courts,
That long hath bound our race,
The gates of heaven are wide,
For She[3] who fell beneath his power,
Now gives the world God's Son.
O knowledge of the Living God,
For Christ hath come to call it back,

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the East (by 1911)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the East; set to SOUTHWELL by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
